title: Residue-field finite-model criterion for J-2
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Suppose that for every prime ideal $\mathfrak p$ of $R$ and every finite purely inseparable field extension $L/\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime; def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension], with $R\to L$ the residue-field map followed by the given extension, there is an $R$-subalgebra $B\subseteq L$ which is finite as an $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], whose fractions $b/c$ ($b,c\in B$, $c\ne0$) exhaust $L$, and for which $\operatorname{Spec}B$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] contains a nonempty open subset $U$ such that $B_{\mathfrak q}$ is regular local [def-weil-regular-scheme] for every $\mathfrak q\in U$. Then for every finite type $R$-algebra $A$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] the subset $\{\mathfrak q\in\operatorname{Spec}A:A_{\mathfrak q}\text{ is regular local}\}$ is open. Equivalently, $R$ satisfies the J-2 condition of [def-exc-excellent-ring].

source.place: Tag 07PC, lemma-J-2, implication (4) implies (1), with J-0 and J-2 expanded using definition-J (Tag 07P7). The domain model is embedded in its specified fraction field L.

proof.text: For every finite type domain over R, apply [lem-exc-j2-residue-field-criterion-domain]. This is precisely the source implication (4) implies (2), including the tensor-image construction and the separable ascent and finite type descent.

Fix a finite type R-algebra A. It is Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra-noetherian]. Every prime quotient A/p is a domain and finite type over R, because the quotient map is surjective and the images of finite algebra generators generate [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. Apply the preceding domain result to A/p, then [lem-exc-regular-locus-open-from-prime-quotients] gives openness of the regular locus of A. This also covers the zero ring, whose spectrum has no points.
The resulting assertion for every finite type algebra is the expanded J-2 clause of [def-exc-excellent-ring].

proof_origin.place: Tag 07PC, (4) implies (2) implies (1). The domain implication is proved in lem-exc-j2-residue-field-criterion-domain; the main proof applies it to all prime quotients, then applies Tag 07P9.
